To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the HMD-HHD hybrid system is a promising approach for AR applications, 2) the HMD is a more natural display for viewing AR content, 3) the HHD is more natural for interacting with AR content, 4) the HHD should be used to provide a larger selection area, and 5) a combination of HMD and HHD is the best approach for selection tasks.

(1) a combined HMD-HHD hybrid system is a viable platform for AR interaction; (2) the hybrid system outperformed a pure HMD system for both accuracy and speed; (3) a hybrid system with an HMD for viewing and a touch screen tablet for selection outperformed a touch screen tablet with a HMD overlay; (4) the hybrid system with a HMD and touch screen tablet is a good platform for mobile AR applications.
a HMD with a HHD is a viable mobile AR system that can provide a more natural and intuitive interaction experience for selection tasks.

the design and implementation of a hybrid HHD-HMD mobile AR system and the development of interaction techniques that leverage the strengths of each of the devices.
the design of a hybrid mobile AR interaction technique that combines the benefits of both HHD and HMD.
the development and evaluation of interaction techniques for a HHD-HMD system that combines the benefits of both types of devices.

there is no single best technique.
the hybrid device offers a better user experience than a HMD or HHD alone.

the hybrid HMD-HHD system provides a good alternative to HMD-only systems for selection tasks in AR, but that the hybrid HHD-HMD system is inferior to HHD-only systems for selection and manipulation tasks.

the HHD is a better device than the HMD for performing selection tasks.
the hybrid system is a good compromise between HHD and HMD interaction techniques, and that the hybrid system can improve the performance and user experience of AR interaction tasks.

the HMD-HHD system can be used to provide a better user experience compared to either the HHD or HMD alone.
